narrative: Automate 2026's first-time NVIDIA-sponsored Humanoid Robot Pavilion gathers more than twenty platforms under a banner of moving from humanoid research to commercial deployment. That dense, vertically-integrated entrant field is the structural pressure that pulls a second high-volume automaker toward its own humanoid program. The breadth is real; the specific second maker is not yet visible.
remaining_gap: Pavilion platforms are unnamed by maker, so no second automaker has disclosed a humanoid program with a working prototype and production cost-down target.
